title: Game-Theoretic Solvers with Bayesian Opponent Modeling and Moral Rhetoric Framing for GLEE
abstract: arXiv:2610.37397v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We describe the agent we submitted to the GLEE Competition, which plays bargaining, negotiation, and persuasion games against a shared pool of human and AI opponents. The agent is built around three central components: a classical game-theoretic solver to compute numeric moves, an online Bayesian layer to estimate opponent archetypes, and a language model to write accompanying messages. We utilize Rubinstein bargaining for bargaining, Faratin concession for negotiation, and Kamenica--Gentzkow disclosure for persuasion, and adapt those models to live opponents using two separate layers: a Bayesian estimate of the opponent's hidden discount factor, reservation value, or signaling reliability, and a Thompson sampling bandit over five moral-foundation framings coupled with an evidence-intuition spectrum to establish message register. Most of the development effort went into the recurring problem that theoretically optimal policies perform

translated_title: 面向GLEE竞赛的博弈论求解器：结合贝叶斯对手建模与道德修辞框架
translated_abstract: 我们描述了提交给GLEE竞赛的智能体，该智能体在与人类和AI对手共享的对手池中进行讨价还价、谈判和说服博弈。该智能体围绕三个核心组件构建：用于计算数值动作的经典博弈论求解器、用于估计对手原型的在线贝叶斯层，以及用于撰写配套消息的语言模型。我们采用Rubinstein讨价还价模型处理议价、Faratin让步模型处理谈判、Kamenica-Gentzkow披露模型处理说服，并通过两个独立的层次将这些模型适配到真实对手：其一是对对手隐藏的贴现因子、保留价值或信号可靠性进行贝叶斯估计；其二是在五种道德基础框架上运行汤普森采样老虎机，并结合证据-直觉光谱来确定消息的语调。大部分开发工作致力于解决一个反复出现的问题：理论上最优的策略在实际表现中……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一种面向GLEE竞赛的博弈智能体，将经典博弈论求解器、贝叶斯对手建模以及基于汤普森采样的道德框架消息生成相结合，以应对讨价还价、谈判和说服博弈。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a game-playing agent for the GLEE Competition that integrates classical game-theoretic solvers, Bayesian opponent modeling, and Thompson-sampling-based moral framing for message generation in bargaining, negotiation, and persuasion games.
